verdict.rationale: Kick publishes a full llms.txt index (confirmed live via probe returning HTTP 200) plus markdown mirrors on every doc page and a dynamic ask-query interface, making the docs directly agent-legible; this is corroborated by both claimed-docs and an independent probe. missing for 10: no third-party/community report of an agent actually consuming llms.txt successfully, and no evidence of structured schema.org/agent-manifest beyond GitBook's generic surfaces.
